acceptanceCriteria: The test reports go list's stderr (exec.ExitError.Stderr) on failure.
The cause is identified from a failing CI log, and either the read scope or the invocation is fixed, or the ticket records it under the V1-0849 flake umbrella with the evidence.
body: Suspected (not confirmed) flake. cmd/corvint-test/main_test.go:115 runs exec.Command("go","list","-deps","../corvint").Output() and on error calls t.Fatal(err), which discards stderr. In CI run 39092839754 job 117573437918 (beamfall/corvint#1086, docs-only on top of claude/cce-e2e-companion-1665, go-product-shard (0), Landlock-confined per .corvint/test-read-scopes.json, ubuntu, 2026-10-18) it failed in 0.09s with only 'main_test.go:117: exit status 1'. The same test with identical code and read scopes passed in run 39093442555 (beamfall/corvint#1081). Expected: pass, or a failure that names the go list error. Actual: opaque intermittent failure. Cause unknown; candidates are Landlock denying a path go list reads (GOROOT, GOMODCACHE, GOENV) or a concurrent build-cache condition.
title: Suspected flake: TestCCEV0015CoreBoundary fails with a bare 'exit status 1' from go list -deps
